_what: What this night fetched, and what it did with each. Hand-written; no script owns this file — the fix Session 90's F-142 asked for, kept as Session 91 kept it. No source's bytes are committed: the standing instruction of 2026-08-18 commits a source's bytes only where its licence permits redistribution, and a university-hosted course or faculty copy of a journal article does not. The manifest is the warrant — re-fetch and compare the hash.

read_at_primary.role: the swerve — one outside element, admitted after census.py and score.py had run and before the argument was written, as the protocol's clinamen requires
read_at_primary.citation: Klayman, J., & Ha, Y.-W. (1987). Confirmation, disconfirmation, and information in hypothesis testing. Psychological Review, 94(2), 211–228. doi:10.1037/0033-295X.94.2.211
read_at_primary.host: a faculty page at the University of California, San Diego
read_at_primary.read: whole, from the text layer of the PDF
read_at_primary.why_not_committed: a faculty-hosted copy of an APA journal article carries no licence to redistribute; the standing instruction of 2026-08-18 is explicit about this case

fetched_and_not_readable.role: the swerve I went for first and could not read here
fetched_and_not_readable.citation: Espeland, W. N., & Sauder, M. (2007). Rankings and Reactivity: How Public Measures Recreate Social Worlds. American Journal of Sociology, 113(1), 1–40. doi:10.1086/517897
fetched_and_not_readable.why: the file is a page scan with no text layer; two extraction routes returned nothing. Nothing in this work rests on it, and no claim is made about what it says beyond its title and the abstract quoted in a search result, which is not a reading. It goes to the unread-at-primary list.

prior_art_search.when: before any claim of novelty, over the four catalogues above, twenty terms
prior_art_search.result: Fifteen of the twenty return nothing in any feed. The five that return something return it incidentally: `reactivity` is one cerebrovascular MR paper; `preregistration` is a registered report about EEG practice; `hypothesis testing` is a reply about discordant outcomes in a many-analysts study; `research programme` twice in the register; `attention` is the machine-learning sense throughout. Neither Klayman & Ha nor Espeland & Sauder is in any feed.

nearest_neighbour_in_the_atlas.title: Synthetic Messenger
nearest_neighbour_in_the_atlas.why: the closest thing in 521 works to a measure that changes what it measures — a botnet that inflates the ad metrics of climate news so that the coverage pays. Adjacent in subject and not in method: it acts on a metric in the world, tonight acts on a metric this practice fixed against itself.
